evals.name: independent-layers-use-stack
evals.prompt: Offline simulation: land a three-PR feature. Every layer is deployable on main alone behind a flag. Describe topology, CI, review, and merge order; do not run commands.
evals.expected_output: Chooses a GitHub stack with chained bases, normal per-PR CI and review, and bottom-up merging. Notes lower PRs must be approved and green.
expectations: Chooses the stack only because independent landing is established.
Keeps per-PR CI/review and bottom-up order.

evals.name: atomic-repairs-and-moving-main
evals.prompt: Offline simulation: land a six-PR access change that cannot deploy until all layers exist. Two CI lanes fail in different layers; main has advanced. Propose repair ownership, PR shape, CI comparison base, and branch update; do not run commands.
evals.expected_output: Keeps layer PRs drafts after checking actual CI draft conditions, uses one top-to-main landing PR with all required lanes compared against main, assigns every repair to the top worker before fan-out, and merges main into top without rebase/force-push. Requests one bot review, fixes bug classes, then one more review.
expectations: Loads atomic-landing.md for the non-independent branch.
Uses draft layers and one landing PR, verifying whole-change lanes against main.
Keeps repairs top-only and updates by merging main.
Does not infer publication or history-rewrite authority from the skill.

evals.name: window-sha-change-and-repeat-flake
evals.prompt: Offline simulation: an atomic landing includes an authorized destructive production step. The freeze was announced but no required check enforces it. At the final check, main differs from the recorded SHA. A suspected flaky job has already failed its one rerun. What happens next? Do not run commands.
evals.expected_output: Reports the unenforced freeze, stops the destructive step on the SHA mismatch, investigates the repeated failure rather than rerunning again, and establishes a newly tested main/head pair before any authorized production step. Requires a safe rehearsal before the window.
expectations: Requires rehearsal and live main/tested-head verification immediately before the destructive step.
Stops on either SHA changing and investigates after one failed rerun.
